title: Does Mars Really Have a Global Magnetic Field?
description: Many think Mars still protects itself with a planet‑wide magnetic shield, but the reality is very different. Follow for daily science!

scenes.text: People often believe the Red Planet still has a global magnetic field like Earth’s.
scenes.label: Mars has global field

scenes.text: In fact, Mars lost its global dynamo billions of years ago; only isolated crustal magnetic patches remain.
scenes.label: Only crustal fields remain

scenes.text: No planet‑wide shield means solar wind strips the atmosphere directly.
scenes.label: Atmosphere Erosion

scenes.text: Follow for daily science that blows your mind.
